effect_description_eng:
[When Digivolving] Activate 1 of the effects below.
・ ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 3 of your opponent's Digimon.
・ Digivolve 1 of your other Digimon into a level 6 or lower Digimon card with [Garurumon] in its name in your hand without paying its cost.
・This Digimon and another of your Digimon may DNA digivolve into a Digimon card in the hand.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If this Digimon has [Omnimon] in its name, trash the top card of your opponent's security stack.
